services.desc: Kenai Drift Anglers offers World-class Alaska Salmon Fishing Charters on the Kenai & Kasilof River. In fact, we’re located in Soldotna, Alaska just minutes away from the start of your next fishing trip. So you want to go salmon fishing in Alaska? You’ve came to the right place, in fact Kenai Drift Anglers has delivered top Alaska salmon fishing charters, for years. It’s no secret, the Kenai River holds many records, from the World Record King Salmon “Les Anderson 97 LBS” to the largest road accessible Sockeye salmon Run in the world, averaging 2.8 Million Sockeye salmon a season. With all the awards over the years, it’s truly put the Kenai River as the Salmon epicenter of the world; however

blurb: Kenai Drift Anglers offers guided fishing tours on the Kenai River and Kasilof River in Alaska. They provide expert local guides with deep knowledge of the rivers and fishing techniques. Guests fish for salmon and trout with opportunities to catch trophy fish.

quotes.author: Chris Parnell
quotes.text: Chris Parnell2 years agoYou know you are with a top guide when you are first off the river with your limit bag! Scott is a top guide with great local knowledge, excellent communication and a good all round person to spend a day fishing with. As we travelled from the other side of the world to experience fishing in Alaska with Scott we couldn't fault his service and communication. Right from time of booking to when he handed us our filleted salmon at the end of a great days fishing. Thanks Scotty we hope we can return to your beautiful country sometime soon.

quotes.author: Kate McMahon
quotes.text: Kate McMahon2 years agoScotty is an awesome guide. He is very knowledgeable and patient with any level. We were a group from 70yrs to 19 yrs old. He is a great teacher of the skills you need. We had such an amazing time on the Kenai. We got 17 great sockeyes. 48 lbs of filets. I hadn’t fished the Kenai in 50 years. We had the best time. That river is Beautiful and Scotty knows the best spots. We were so lucky to have him. He is a really nice guy. Thx Scotty an unforgettable day on the Kenai.

quotes.author: Herbert Butcher
quotes.text: Herbert Butcher2 years agoScott (owner) was very helpful in recommending the best dates for the type of trip we wanted to have. Scott was timely in answering any questions we had and set us up with Logan as our guide. Logan did an outstanding job. He got us setup for the sockeye salmon run perfectly and we caught all 3 of our limits before 7am. Perfect trip.

quotes.author: Amanda Baez
quotes.text: Amanda Baez2 years agoMy husband and I had an absolute blast fishing with Scott on our honeymoon! He took the time to teach us the technique and we caught our max in no time. Would absolutely do it again and recommend him to anyone! He also connected us with a local business to freeze and ship our fish back home which was such a help.

quotes.author: David Bowen
quotes.text: David Bowen2 years agoFished with Scotty on the Kenai and Logan on the Kasilof. They worked super hard, were on time and professional, and helped us limit out all the days we fished with them. Highly recommend these guys and will use them again. Great trip!!!

quotes.author: Krista Goodrich
quotes.text: Krista Goodrich2 years agoExcellent day on the water, caught tons of salmon. He was patient, gave great instructions and most importantly put us on the fish! Thanks for a wonderful experience for our Girls Gone Adventuring Retreat!
